prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, then take it, check properties and execute subtask. Else, approach and process. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToNextLocation    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
